connections.observation: `s005` records the metallurgical sequence (softening, melting, pouring, cutting). `s008` divides this sequence into two stages: useful softening followed by destructive enchantment. The verb sequence in `s005` enacts the two-stage movement that `s008` articulates.

`s007` traces θυμός/θυμοειδής throughout the section. `s005` names the actions that progressively destroy it: softened, melted, poured out, cut from the soul. The recurrence in `s007` supplies the target undergoing the transformations recorded in `s005`.

`s009` shows the μαλακ-/μαλθακ- family running from harmonies through persons to final warrior-product. `s010` places χρήσιμον and ἀχρήστον adjacent at the threshold. Together they mark the point where softening (μαλάσσω) crosses from useful to destructive, producing μαλθακὸν αἰχμητήν.

`s002` contrasts ἀγριότης and ἡμερότης as the two excesses. `s012` places πειθώ/λόγος opposite βία/ἀγριότης in the gymnastics-only person. The ἀγριότης of `s002` returns in `s012` paired with force, enacted as refusal of persuasion through words.

`s001` names θυμοειδές and φιλόσοφος as the two targets. `s018` contrasts the harmonized soul (σώφρων, ἀνδρεία) with the unharmonized (δειλή, ἄγροικος). The pairing in `s001` supplies the elements whose correct combination produces the virtues named in `s018`.

`s003` recurs ἁρμόζω, συναρμόζω, εὐαρμοστότατον across the harmonization theme. `s014` introduces string-tuning (ἐπιτείνω/ἀνίημι, χορδαί) and mixing (κεράννυμι) at the conclusion. The tuning and mixing images enact concretely what the abstract ἁρμόζω family has traced.

`s004` rejects the common view that music serves soul and gymnastics serves body, declaring both for the soul. `s001` replaces that rejected pairing with θυμοειδές and φιλόσοφος as the true targets. The correction in `s004` prepares the new pairing announced in `s001`.

`s006` records three similes: iron, sinews, wild animal. `s002` contrasts ἀγριότης and ἡμερότης. The iron and sinews appear in the music-excess passage; the θηρίον appears in the gymnastics-excess passage describing ἀγριότης. The similes distribute across the two opposed excesses.

`s013` traces μουσική/ἄμουσος through the section, ending with the one who lacks Muses becoming ἄμουσος. `s016` names the consequence: the φιλομαθές becomes ἀσθενές, κωφόν, τυφλόν. The deprivation of Muses in `s013` produces the sensory and cognitive blindness recorded in `s016`.

`s011` clusters pouring and sound (καταυλεῖν, καταχεῖν, χώνη, μινυρίζων). `s005` continues with melting and pouring (τήκει, λείβει, ἐκτήξῃ). The downward-pouring movement in `s011` flows into the liquefaction sequence in `s005`.

`s015` repeats τοῦ δέοντος three times, marking the threshold of excess in both directions, then replaces it with μέχρι τοῦ προσήκοντος. `s003` culminates in συναρμοσθῆτον and εὐαρμοστότατον. The final μέχρι τοῦ προσήκοντος of `s015` names the point at which the harmonization of `s003` is achieved.

`s007` traces θυμοειδές/θυμός from initial target through destruction to final pairing with φιλόσοφος. `s018` contrasts the harmonized soul (σώφρων, ἀνδρεία) with the unharmonized (δειλή, ἄγροικος). The properly maintained θυμοειδές of `s007` yields ἀνδρεία in `s018`; destroyed or weakened θυμός yields δειλή.

`s008` names the two-stage sequence: useful softening, then destructive enchantment producing μαλθακὸν αἰχμητήν. `s015` recurs τοῦ δέοντος marking the boundary. The turning point in `s008` from χρήσιμον to μαλθακόν occurs at the threshold that `s015` repeatedly names.

`s017` attributes the two arts to a god. `s001` names their targets as θυμοειδές and φιλόσοφος. The divine gift in `s017` supplies the two arts whose purpose `s001` corrects from the common misunderstanding.

elements.context: ὀρθῶς μὲν τραφὲν ἀνδρεῖον ἂν εἴη
καλῶς δὲ τραφέντος ἥμερόν τε καὶ κόσμιον

new_signals.observation: τρέφω recurs three times: θυμοειδές rightly nourished becomes brave, φιλόσοφος well nourished becomes gentle and orderly, φιλομαθές not nourished becomes weak, deaf, and blind.

elements.context: ὀρθῶς μὲν τραφὲν ἀνδρεῖον ἂν εἴη
τοῦ μὲν ἡρμοσμένου σώφρων τε καὶ ἀνδρεία ἡ ψυχή

new_signals.observation: ἀνδρεῖος/ἀνδρεία appears three times: as product of rightly nourished θυμοειδές, as comparative describing the gymnastics-only person initially, and as virtue of the harmonized soul.

elements.context: ἐπιτεινομένω καὶ ἀνιεμένω μέχρι τοῦ προσήκοντος

new_signals.observation: ἐπιτείνω/ἐπέχω recur: θυμοειδές overstrained (ἐπιταθέν) becomes harsh, music holding on (ἐπέχων) without release destroys θυμός, the two natures must be tightened and loosened (ἐπιτεινομένω καὶ ἀνιεμένω) to the proper point.
The music-excess passage explicitly marks temporal stages with πρῶτον and μετὰ τοῦτο, dividing useful softening from destructive continuation.

elements.context: εἴ τι καὶ ἐνῆν αὐτοῦ φιλομαθὲς ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ
τὸ ἥμερον οὐχ ἡ φιλόσοφος ἂν ἔχοι φύσις
ἐπὶ τὸ θυμοειδὲς καὶ τὸ φιλόσοφον
μουσικῆς δὲ καὶ φιλοσοφίας μὴ ἅπτηται

new_signals.observation: The φιλ- learning family appears as φιλόσοφος nature (twice), φιλοσοφία paired with music, and φιλομαθές element in the soul, naming the target and its deprivation.
